newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean cabinet to offer resignation.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean cabinet to offer resignation.

text.p: South Korea's cabinet ministers and top ruling party officials will offer to resign en masse to give President Kim Young-sam a free hand to reshuffle his administration, government officials said on Tuesday.
Kim's top presidential Blue House aides have told the president they are prepared to go, one aide told Reuters.
The move came after Kim apologised in "agony and sorrow" earlier on Tuesday for a loan scandal and the controversial passage of a new labour law that sparked nearly a month of wildcat strikes.
"The resignation en masse is a common procedure aimed at giving him a free hand," the aide said.
"Now that the president has indicated he will carry out a major reshuffle in the government and the party, cabinet ministers will soon express their intention to resign," a government official said.
Kim has frequently reshuffled his cabinet as his administration stumbles from one crisis to another.
